description: This file defines a modern design system for a medical exam prep application, including color palette, typography, spacing, border radius, shadows, and functions to generate global CSS styles and styled UI components.

methods.name: get_global_css
methods.description: Returns a string containing global CSS styles for the application, including font imports, scrollbar styling, header styles, metric styles, button styles, input fields, tabs, expander, chat messages, sidebar, progress bar, alert boxes, data frame, file uploader, and custom classes.

methods.name: create_metric_card
methods.description: Generates an HTML string for a styled metric card with title, value, optional delta indicator, icon, and color.

methods.name: create_stat_badge
methods.description: Creates an HTML string for a small stat badge with a label, value, and badge type.
